name: Local dev servers
ownerWords: A 200 check is a good duty too. Hand the 200 checks of the wiki, the frontend app, Convex and the crawler API in the local environment to the ops chat.
goal: The wiki (localhost:5176), the search app (localhost:5174), local Convex and the local crawler-v3 API each answer 200 within 5 s, the wiki's pm2 tree stays under 4096 MB, and pm2 restarts the wiki or search at most once a day. Tell the owner only when a server does not answer, the wiki is over its cap, or a server keeps restarting.

metrics.label: Local servers not answering 200 within 5 s
Real memory of the wiki's pm2 process tree
pm2 restarts of the wiki or search since the last run

onMiss: Read the flagged items; each service's answer is there, and by_design means the search app uses a remote one. Wiki or search not answering: in auto-sns-agent read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs <llm-wiki|search> --lines 200 --nostream`, find the cause, and restart it with that pm2 only if it still does not answer. Convex or crawler: run `node scripts/dev/devstack.mjs status` and follow ops/runbooks/local-runtime.md. Over the cap or restarting: find the root (dev-guard.mjs logs exits; `Stopping app` in .cache/pm2-dev/pm2.log is a restart command) and start one job that fixes it with `commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name>`. Tell the owner what broke and whether it answers now. All on target: no message.
